theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_cri_carrier_dilation_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))) → (∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → μ B = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ B, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))) → (∀ (s : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 < s → μ (s • A) = ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n * μ A) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) {w : Euclidean N | w ∈ M ∧ s • w ∉ M} = 0 ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) {w : Euclidean N | s • w ∈ M ∧ w ∉ M} = 0
